evidence.statement: Fastify composition root: trustProxy true, GET-only CORS from CORS_ORIGIN, /ws and /chat WebSocket endpoints registered, chat room constructed with env admin key.
Unauthenticated /ws hub; all frames validated by shared parseClientMessage; watch capped at 20 instruments.

Unauthenticated nickname-identity chat with admin-key moderation, per-connection cooldowns, IP/nick bans, roster with IPs persisted to disk/Redis, server geo lookup via ipwho.is, image data-URL constraint.
RLS: profiles public-select/own-insert/own-update with column-level UPDATE grant excluding is_admin; user_emails own-write and admin-read; admin_settings admin-read only.
evidence.limitations: repo SQL is intent; live application unverifiable here

evidence.statement: Two OANDA practice tokens hardcoded in the frontend bundle, documented as deliberate practice-only browser-direct access.
Three open Cloudflare relays: edge forwards all paths to Render appending client-supplied XFF to CF-Connecting-IP; oanda and binance workers serve CORS-* relays with no auth or rate limits.
CSP and security headers exist only on the Vercel deploy path; netlify.toml defines no headers.
Session JWT mirrored to a SameSite=Lax cookie without Secure; visitors self-report IP/country from third-party echo services into user_emails.
Sanitized evidence bundle E1-E27 with gaps G1-G6 covering routes, hub, chat, Supabase RLS, workers, configs and web services.

coverage.reason: Primary `web` (quick/web.md): the decision dominates on the browser-to-origin boundary and the rendered-user-content/private-data lifecycle of the SPA, its session authority and its edge-served content — the surface where the caller's fix decision matters most. Evidence: E-01, E-05, E-07, E-08 (bundle E13/E20/E11). Limits: does not by itself cover the chat identity lifecycle or the open worker relays, hence two bounded secondaries.

Bounded to the /chat WebSocket room, its nickname identity model, moderation state and roster (E-03; bundle E7). Adds the identity-spoofing and moderation-authority boundaries that `web` alone would under-model. Excludes the market /ws fan-out beyond its shared no-auth property.

Bounded to the Cloudflare Workers (edge/oanda/binance) and the Netlify candles function (E-06, E-07; bundle E17-E19): adds the open-relay and IP-forwarding boundaries distinct from the origin. Excludes CI/CD and warmup cron internals (no distinct boundary evidence).
